description: The ported actionsCsv() output is locked at exactly 12 columns by analytics.test.ts — the differentiation layer's new Last Activity/Risk columns must go into the UI-facing QueueTable CSV only, never into this function.
kpi.conversion must render as null (rendered as —) when fewer than 10 matured leads exist, never as a misleading 0%.

detectAnomalies()'s raw output (consumed by the locked test suite) must stay severity-sorted; rankAnomalies() is a display-layer wrapper that must never mutate or reorder the underlying ctx.anomalies array itself.

pdfkit's core Helvetica font cannot render ₹ or → — a prior bug let a raw → through in the Recommended Actions section by constructing that line outside the sanitizeReport() pass. The PDF export must never contain a literal ₹ or → byte.
GEMINI_API_KEY and the @google/genai SDK must never appear in .next/static (client bundle).
.env.example must survive the blanket .env* gitignore rule so it can be committed as onboarding documentation.
/api/ask must return a usable deterministic answer (not an error) when GEMINI_API_KEY is unset.
get_forecast must return {available:false, reason:...} rather than a number when fewer than 10 matured leads exist in scope — never fabricate a forecast.
The high-value-stale risk label's deal-value cutoff must be computed from the live open-lead distribution (75th percentile), never a hardcoded rupee figure.
